info.name: MOH_External_API_Top_15_APIs
info.description:
MOH.Web API – controller-wise. **Parameter rule:**
• **FromBody (simple params)** → use **form-data** in Postman (Body → form-data, add key/value pairs).
• **Entity (MOH.Entity)** → use **raw JSON** in Postman (Body → raw, type JSON).
Set {{baseUrl}} from API_URL_LIST_MERGED.xlsx (sheets: common, Foundation_Service_Merged).

Filtered to retain only the first 15 API request items in original Postman collection order, including their pre-request scripts, test scripts, requests, responses, folders, collection events, and variables.
